title: ‘No intention to attack N Korea’: S Korea Prez Lee after Trump reduces US drills
summary_full: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung advocates for stronger independent defense capabilities.  He defended annual civil-defense exercises as purely defensive measures.  These drills occur alongside joint US-South Korea military exercises.  President Trump previously instructed the Pentagon to substantially reduce joint military drills.  Seoul plans to continue strengthening its own defense while maintaining its alliance.
